name: drawio_create
title: Create draw.io diagram
description: Turns drawio XML into a deliverable that opens directly in a browser. Writes viewer HTML (.html; opening it redirects to draw.io) to out_path and, by default, also writes a rendered PNG (useful for checking the rendering). icon:// references are resolved to data URIs and embedded. Before generating, it checks the diagram labels against the text rules and generates nothing if there is a violation. The font and font size are checked against the theme declaration (theme, or the theme of the talk-dir that is an ancestor of the diagram), and the result is returned in theme.

input_path.description: Absolute path of the input .drawio file. Windows-style paths (C:\... / \\wsl.localhost\<distro>\...) are accepted and converted to an absolute path under /mnt/<drive>/ or inside WSL.

mode.description: Purpose of the generated URL (view / edit). The generated URL is the same for both

out_path.description: Absolute path of the .html file to write the viewer HTML to (opening it redirects to draw.io). If omitted, only the URL is returned in url. Windows-style paths (C:\... / \\wsl.localhost\<distro>\...) are accepted and converted to an absolute path under /mnt/<drive>/ or inside WSL.

theme.description: Theme used to check the font and font size: `git+https://<host>/<owner>/<repo>.git#<tag>`, `file:<absolute path>`, or the absolute path of a talk-dir or a theme root. If omitted, the theme of the talk-dir is used when the diagram is under its `public/`; otherwise the built-in default (sans-serif) is used. When the diagram for a slide is placed outside the talk-dir, pass the absolute path of the talk-dir. Windows-style paths (C:\... / \\wsl.localhost\<distro>\...) are accepted and converted to an absolute path under /mnt/<drive>/ or inside WSL.

png.description: Whether to also write a PNG as a sibling file (<out_path with the extension replaced by .png>) when out_path is given

event.description: drawio.url.done on success, drawio.url.error on failure (omitted when a path argument is rejected)

url.description: Generated draw.io URL (success only, when out_path is omitted)

file.description: Absolute path of the written viewer HTML (success only, when out_path is given)

png.description: Absolute path of the written PNG, or null when writing it failed (success only, when out_path is given and png is true)

pngFailed.description: Whether writing the PNG failed (success only, when out_path is given and png is true)

source.description: Where the theme came from: talk-dir (ancestor talk-dir of the diagram), option (theme argument), default (built-in default)

name.description: Package name of the theme (omitted for the built-in default)

body.description: Body fonts the labels are checked against

eastAsian.description: East Asian font (omitted when the theme does not declare one)

fonts.description: Fonts the labels are checked against

fontSizes.description: Font sizes (px) the labels are checked against (only when the theme came from a talk-dir or the theme argument)

theme.description: Theme the font and font size were checked against (success only)

violations.description: Text rule violations (failure only, kind text-violation)

invalidPaths.description: Rejected path arguments as <parameter>=<value> (failure only, kind invalid-path)

convertedPaths.description: Windows-style path arguments converted before the rejection, keyed by parameter name (failure only, kind invalid-path; omitted when nothing was converted)

detail.description: Full text of the failure and how to recover (failure only)

log.description: Raw output of the command or child process (failure only). Over 64KB, the end is kept and the first line notes the truncation

warnings.description: Warnings raised during the run (omitted when there are none). Beyond 100 warnings or 64KB, the last item tells how many were omitted
